subject.title: Control UI: drag sessions from the sidebar into split view with animated drop preview

question: Should Control UI add sidebar-session drag-and-drop into split-view panes now, and should the product contract include the full left/right/top/bottom/center animated drop-zone model described here?
rationale: This is a new user-facing web interaction on a protected maintainer-labeled issue, and it defines how split panes, sidebar selection, attachment drops, animation, and responsive behavior should work together.

options.title: Sponsor the full drop-zone model
options.body: Implement the requested private session drag payload, animated pane preview, edge insertion, center replacement, active-pane update, reduced-motion path, and browser proof.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Start with sidebar drag to replace the targeted pane or insert right only, then track richer stacked/animated placement separately after UX proof.

options.title: Defer the gesture
options.body: Keep the current header-button and pane-session-selector flow if the added drag/drop complexity is not worth the ergonomic gain right now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full drop-zone model
recommendation.body: Implement the requested private session drag payload, animated pane preview, edge insertion, center replacement, active-pane update, reduced-motion path, and browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the split-view foundation and filed this precise follow-up, so he is the best available owner for the product boundary.
